Monthly updates

Small notes, said plainly. What shipped, what changed, and what stayed steady.

Last updated: August 3, 2026

Privacy promise (unchanged)

  • No ads.
  • No data sold.
  • Most features work without an account.
  • On-device by default; optional sync only when chosen.

Full details: Privacy policy · Security.

August 2026

  • Mercy front door: Home asks first, “How much room do you have?”—Too much goes to Calm, One verse is enough stays with today’s lesson, A little more room opens Find a path (one feeling → one existing door). No new campus wings; clearer doors to what already ships.
  • Return to quiet: Deep rooms (Calm, Explore, Life Lessons, Learn the Word, University) end with a soft way back to Home, Calm, or Find a path.
  • Kids Remember: Story Library keeps coloring and adds a gentle Hear→Remember order game plus soft quiz copy—no scoreboard pressure, progress on this device.
  • Plans entry: Mobile “Start here” lanes wrap more calmly so the library stays deep without feeling like a wall on a phone.
  • Direction (for builders and returning friends): Prefer reducing friction over adding surface. Solo capacity still matters; shipped quiet is enough.

June 2026

  • Discoverability (June 2026): Honest path cards on Home (after today’s verse and feel-search results), Battle Plan day view, Today’s Lesson, Kids Battle, and Family hub—one primary door each, extras tucked in quiet <details>. Explore gained a porch map band and feeling-first hub tile subtitles. Calm, My Study, and Plans hero link back to today’s verse and the map. Builder docs: principles, system.

May 2026

  • Porch polish (May 2026): Calmer daily verse typography, a device-only “slow breath?” note on Home (no analytics), tighter Battle Plans hero reading width, a gentler Kids welcome band, and five porch-calm image presets plus two new free starter cards (Matthew 11:28, Philippians 4:6–7). Builder reference: Visual north star.
  • Home: A calm “heavy week?” line above the fold points to the 7-day emergency calm pack for when seven gentle days fit better than browsing.
  • Seasonal: New Father’s Day doorway (June)—honest links for dads, marriage, parenting, and family rhythm reads; no hype.
  • New After a hard conversation Battle Plan (7 days, KJV)—for when words landed wrong and the room still feels cold; pairs with Marriage.
  • Kids Corner: Five more Gentle Journey stories on the path toward 365—Jordan crossing, Abigail’s wisdom, Anna at the temple, wedding at Cana, and Psalm 23 as shepherd.
  • Sharper Share on Home and Today’s Lesson: KJV ref, verse excerpt, “one small step” when present, and a clean link (Home lands on today’s verse block) so forwarding to a weary friend is one tap, not a vague plug.
  • Email and Text beside Share on Home (verse toolbar) and on Today’s Lesson: opens the device mail or SMS app with the same honest body plus link—no backend, no account.
  • New Offline porch checklist (printable): PWA install notes, what caches on first Wi‑Fi visit, offline vs online table, refresh tips, and links to Print hub + Emergency pack—footer “Further In” points here.
  • Desktop SMS friend-send hidden when the pointer is fine and the window is wide—avoids a dead sms: link; Email + Share stay everywhere.
  • Footer now surfaces Monthly updates and the Emergency calm pack beside transparency and reader stories.
  • Shipped the 7-Day Emergency Calm Pack doorway for heavy weeks; tightened links between Home, Plans, Family, and Print hub for faster next steps.
  • Strengthened metadata on key pages to improve crawlability of JS-heavy sections.
  • The reading plans are now simply called KJV Battle Plans — same calm days, same KJV, no extra names. Every door is still open; nothing was removed.

April 2026

  • Expanded family and mission print doors while keeping local-first privacy defaults.
  • Added clearer “start here” and first-visit guidance across major hub pages.
  • Improved calm navigation and “pick up where you left off” language in key flows.

March 2026

  • Refreshed study tools and print-friendly paths for home and church contexts.
  • Expanded language pilots and improved language coverage notes in Explore.
  • Kept all core doors intact: search, quick topics, plans, family, and prayer.
